required_fixes: The screen's representation layer (html.parser without JavaScript) cannot observe JS-rendered capability tokens, which caused 4 of 5 positive anchors to fail G0.2. To reach the ACCEPT branch, the instrument must either (a) add JavaScript execution capability to observe tokens on sites like auth.wikimedia.org, meta.discourse.org, or (b) restrict the anchor set and candidate pool to sites proven to server-render tokens in raw HTML (e.g., GitLab-family only). The current design's G0.2 gate requires >=2 of 5 positive anchors to pass; with the current representation layer, only CAL-POS-1 can ever pass on the execution date.

The frozen arithmetic certificate's preconditions (>=2 positive anchors passing G0.2) are not met in execution, making the adequacy gates A1-A6 unreachable. The certificate is internally satisfiable (V02 passes) but its preconditions depend on instrument capabilities that the current representation layer does not provide. A redesign must either strengthen the representation layer or adjust the anchor set and G0.2 threshold to match what the instrument can actually observe.

Candidate screening used only 2 sessions per host (not the full K=4) and found 5 GitLab-family hosts with AGSI but only 1 distinct value each. A full 4-session capture with body-hash comparison is needed to determine whether these hosts actually rotate tokens per session or whether the tokens are session-invariant on these specific instances.
validity_findings: GATE 0 correctly short-circuited to MEASUREMENT_INVALID per the frozen decision rule: G0.2 requires >=2 of 5 positive anchors to pass; only CAL-POS-1 (gitlab.com) passed with 4 distinct authenticity_token values across 4 sessions. This is a valid execution of the frozen design, not a defect.

The primary validity threat is V16 (representation loss): html.parser without JavaScript execution means JS-rendered capability tokens are structurally invisible. CAL-POS-2 (auth.wikimedia.org), CAL-POS-3 (en.wikipedia.org), and CAL-POS-4 (meta.discourse.org) all serve token fields in HTML but populate values via JavaScript, yielding 0 distinct values in raw HTML. This is a measurement-instrument limitation, not a scientific finding about C-FRESHNESS.

CAL-POS-5 (bugs.launchpad.net) returned HTTP 404 on all 4 sessions; the URL no longer serves the expected page. This is recorded as HOST_UNREACHABLE_IS_NOT_A_REJECTION per the negative anchor protocol.
The negative anchors (CAL-NEG-1 through CAL-NEG-4) were all correctly rejected with NO_AGSI_DETECTED across all 4 sessions each. G0.3 passed as required.

Session isolation (V05, NC-SESSION-ISOLATION) was verified: fresh CookieJar per session, no Cookie header on first request, new TCP/TLS connections (Connection: close). Per-session cookie-jar digests are recorded in raw evidence.

No injected drift (V04): all 132 requests were real HTTP GETs to public origins. No fixtures, no local server, no synthetic data. Labels would have been raw byte comparisons had a scored population been reached.

Host pool disjointness (V14): static exclusion union verified. CAL-NEG-4 (httpbin.org) is in the historical frontier/graph host union but declared as instrument and excluded from candidate pool, with collision disclosed. Dynamic check against concurrent frontier/physics pools could not be performed (files not available); M-POOL-DISJOINT-DYNAMIC-VERIFIED = false recorded.

Transport discipline (V19): ~2.2s pacing between same-host requests, one frozen User-Agent, no retries on HTTP status, per-host cap 40 and global cap 2500 not approached (132 total requests). Bot-challenge hosts (403, 418, timeouts) recorded as BLOCKED and excluded.

The experiment did NOT convert the GATE 0 failure into a scientific negative. Validity notes explicitly state: 'The experiment is NOT a falsification of C-FRESHNESS. The instrument failed its own calibration, not the hypothesis.' This correctly preserves the measurement-validity vs. scientific-falsification distinction.

The arithmetic reachability certificate (V02) was verified satisfiable at freeze and re-verified at execution. However, its preconditions (>=2 positive anchors passing) were not met, so the adequacy gates A1-A6 were never reached. This is correctly reported as a precondition failure, not a certificate failure.
baseline_findings: B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY: Not evaluated (no scored population). Correctly excluded from all accept/falsifier conditions per mandatory disclosure. Its false-accept is an algebraic identity equal to prevalence.
B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY: Not evaluated (no scored population). The incumbent rule (value-blind structure signature OR transport-validator change) is structurally incapable of reading recorded values.

PC-CANDIDATE-SENSITIVITY: FAIL. Only 1 of 5 positive anchors passed (CAL-POS-1). The pooled Fisher exact test requires >=2 passing anchors to be computable. With only 1 anchor, M-ANCHOR-POWER-FISHER-P is not computable. This is the direct cause of G0.2 failure.
PC-INCUMBENT-BLINDNESS: UNKNOWN. Not reached due to G0.2 failure. The structural prediction of M-FA-INCUMBENT-POS = 1.0 on these anchors (value-blind on server-minted tokens) remains untested.

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS remains at HYPOTHESIS. The experiment did not validly execute on the preregistered substrate because the instrument (screen with html.parser, no JavaScript) failed its own calibration (G0.2). The failure is a measurement-instrument limitation (V16 representation loss), not a falsification of the C-FRESHNESS hypothesis. No claim-level statement in either direction is licensed. The guard's capability on real credential-free public HTTP remains unmeasured. The ACCEPT branch and all falsifiers F1-F8 are unreachable because GATE 0 blocked. F9 (terminal, not falsification) applies.
unresolved: Whether the screen's detection power can be extended to JS-rendered sites (Wikimedia, Discourse, Launchpad) requires either a JS-capable substrate (browser/Playwright) or a server-side rendering detection service. This is a runtime lane substrate question.

The 5 GitLab-family hosts that showed AGSI had only 1 distinct value across 2 screening sessions. A full 4-session capture with body-hash comparison is needed to determine if these hosts actually rotate tokens per session.

Permission-boundary change (SB-01, F3 drift family) remains unreachable on credential-free public origins. The exact next action is a credentialed single-write freshness-vs-permission probe; no lane currently certifies a substrate for it.

The structurally-undetectable stale cell (SB-05): a stale item whose exact value is byte-identical across sessions due to server-side token recycling or server-side validity binding remains unmeasurable without write verbs. M-INVISIBLE-STALE-PREV is null and may never satisfy a gate.
The economic arm (part iv of the Director's strategic question) is entirely unmeasured because the guard's operating point was never reached.
Whether the screen's detection power can be improved by examining computed form action URLs, Set-Cookie headers, or redirect chains (not just raw input values) is an open engineering question.

The frozen arithmetic certificate's preconditions (>=2 positive anchors passing) are not met on this execution date with this representation layer. Whether the certificate's preconditions can be met on a future execution with the same instrument is unknown.
